0.reason: Real race, filed as a-read-answers-inside-its-deadline §77: the persisted identity is stamped after the entries are read, so a record filed in that window can be left out until the directory moves

1.reason: The assertion is redundant with the path assertion beside it, which independently requires the reviewer's own record

2.reason: Provenance wording in the negative control's header; the observed base counts (138 and 260) show the base tree was measured

findings.text: non-blocking: _persisted_index_document stamps the directory identity by stat'ing the store at persist time, after _update_store_entries or the build has already read the entries, so a record another process files in that window is covered by the recorded identity but missing from the entries, and every later cold process adopts the incomplete set silently until the directory moves again; the identity read at line 1614 is the value that matches what the entries describe and should be passed in.

non-blocking: the assertion compares reviewed['reviewed_head_sha'] against PROMOTED_HEAD, the same constant the test seeded the record with and passed to _promotion_lookups as promoted_revision, so a lookup that echoed the requested revision back instead of returning the stored record would still pass; the independent guard is the neighbouring path assertion at line 242, which asks for REVIEWED_RUN and requires the file named for the reviewer's run.

non-blocking: the negative control's header names the head worktree's review_records.py as the module under test while the command's PYTHONPATH and the observed base behaviour (138 and 260 accesses) show the base tree was imported, so a reader checking the control's provenance sees a contradiction; the manifest also omits measurement_module and measurement_cwd for this scratch-tree arm.
